title: Technology Sector Update for 06/25/2018: T, QUIK, XRX
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.3%
AAPL: -0.7%
IBM: -0.6%
CSCO: flat
GOOG: -1.06%
Technology shares were weaker in pre-market trading on Monday.
Expected movers:
- AT&T ( T ) Chairman and CEO Randall Stephenson said at a conference that the acquisition of Time Warner will allow it to offer premium content with a wide distribution, direct to consumer access
- QuickLogic ( QUIK ) entered into a master technology license deal with C-Sky Microsystems Co.
- Xerox ( XRX ) CEO John Visentin said Fujifilm's suit is a 'desperate and misguided negotiating ploy'
